$comment: The wire-level acceptance criteria, as structured data.
Why this file exists: prose used to state the same fact in three places, and they drifted
apart — one paragraph claimed `upto` settlement was still outstanding while the table two screens
below listed its settled transaction hash. Prose that duplicates a fact will eventually contradict
it. So facts live here once, and the document is generated.
Criteria 4 and 6 have NO entry here on purpose. They are resolved from the runs that measured them —
conformance-dual.json and rejection-audit.json — and the generator refuses to build if anyone writes
one here. They are the two most tempting claims to assert rather than earn, so they are the two that
cannot be written by hand at all.
Every other entry carries `evidence`: what was observed, not what was intended.

criteria.criterion: An unmodified canonical client completes a payment end to end
criteria.evidence: examples/paid-api-agent runs a buyer built from @x402/core + @x402/fetch + @x402/stellar that imports nothing from this repository.

Our stellar:testnet kind is byte-identical to the live public x402.org facilitator's, compared against docs/research/captures/2026-07-30/x402org-supported.json. Truthful, not merely present: the fee for the stock-client settlement was charged to the facilitator, not the buyer.

criteria.criterion: The spec `payload: {transaction}` format is accepted verbatim
criteria.evidence: The stock client's payload is submitted unmodified to /verify and /settle; no local variants and no renamed fields anywhere in the request path.

criteria.criterion: A published settled transaction hash per scheme
criteria.evidence: `exact` and `upto` both settled on testnet; hashes below.

settlements.note: hand-built client, the first end-to-end settlement

3,500,000 settled against a 10,000,000 authorized ceiling, against the current contract CCMM3FMG… which carries the settlement hook (a keypair payer passes hook = None); over-cap and replay both refused in the same run. Supersedes 5ec8b20c…, which settled against the superseded hookless contract CBHDZLYA….
